title: Docs: add troubleshooting for common onboarding errors (401/429/timeouts/streaming disconnects)
author: Wei Chen
description: Context: As part of the guided onboarding checklist work (PM-482), Support has flagged a small set of recurring onboarding failures that block time-to-first-success (401 auth issues, 429 rate limits, request timeouts, and streaming disconnects). This PR adds a canonical troubleshooting section to the docs site and links it from the onboarding path so Console deep links can land on a single, maintained page. Scope: Hosted API only (Phase 1). What’s in here: (1) New Troubleshooting page with a quick decision table (symptom → likely cause → fix) for 401 / 429 / timeouts / streaming disconnects; (2) Concrete copy and examples that match current SDK guidance (retries/backoff, timeouts, request IDs) without requiring users to read the SDK repos; (3) Support-friendly snippets for what to collect (request_id, response headers, timestamp, region) while explicitly avoiding prompt/content collection; (4) Cross-links to API key docs (test vs prod key), quota/rate limit docs, and streaming best practices. Notes: The page intentionally avoids referencing internal tooling and avoids suggesting users paste prompts/logs into tickets; it focuses on metadata and request IDs. Follow-ups: Console checklist deep-linking and UTM tagging will be handled in the checklist rollup PR; this PR just adds stable anchors.
commits: docs(onboarding): add troubleshooting landing page and anchors
docs(api-keys): clarify test vs prod key mismatch symptom under 401
docs(rate-limits): add 429 headers explanation and handling guidance
docs(streaming): add disconnect causes, keepalive/proxy notes, and retry guidance
chore: fix broken links + unify terminology (project/org, prod key)
conversation:
Elliot Price (review): This is a good start. Two asks before approval: (1) Please make the page explicitly call out that 401s are often caused by mixing test/prod keys (we see that a lot) and show users where to check the environment in Console; (2) Please ensure terminology matches the checklist: “Production key” vs “Live key” (we should standardize on “prod key”).
Wei Chen (author): Ack. I’ll add a 401 section callout for test/prod mismatches and update terminology to “test key / prod key” consistently. I’ll also add a short “Where to check in Console” note without screenshots so we don’t couple to UI too tightly.

Priya Shah (review): Support perspective: can we add a short “What to include in a support ticket” section? Request ID, org/project, approximate timestamp, region. Also: please do NOT suggest copying full request bodies or prompts.
Wei Chen (author): Yes. I’ll add a “Collect these details” box and explicitly say “don’t include prompts or customer content”.

Monica Patel (review): Retry guidance: The doc currently says “retry 429s with exponential backoff + jitter, max 10 retries”. Our SDK defaults are lower and we recommend respecting Retry-After when present. Can we phrase this as guidance rather than a hard default, and call out Retry-After?
Wei Chen (author): Good catch. I’ll switch to “respect Retry-After if provided; otherwise exponential backoff w/ jitter” and remove the hard “10 retries” number. I’ll align with the patterns in the SDK onboarding contracts.

Nikhil Sharma (review): For 429s, can we add a note that some 429s are “quota exceeded” vs “rate limit” and point users to the Quotas page in Console? Also: could we mention that the onboarding checklist has a dedicated step for quotas/429 handling (so users understand it’s expected)?
Wei Chen (author): Added a “429 types” subsection and linked to rate limits/quotas docs + Console quotas page. Also added a one-line note that the checklist includes this step.

CI (bot): link-check failed — Broken anchor: /docs/onboarding/troubleshooting#streaming-disconnects referenced from onboarding quickstart.
Wei Chen (author): Fixed the anchor to #streaming-disconnects-and-timeouts and updated the link target.

Elliot Price (review): Re-review looks good. The support metadata box is perfect. Approving.
Priya Shah (review): Approved. This matches what we tell users in SUP-9182 / SUP-9210.
Monica Patel (review): Approved after the retry wording change.

Merge (Wei Chen): Squashed and merged into main.
release_notes: Docs: Added a Troubleshooting page covering common onboarding errors (401 auth, 429 rate limits/quotas, timeouts, streaming disconnects).
Docs: Clarified how to collect request metadata for support without including prompt/content.
